description.name: Entry
description.text:
Fifteen single-target Dark/Poison/NE magical attacks (1.50 each), grants [Twin Element Mode II (Dark, Poison)], [MAG +30%, RES +25% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], Awoken Jester of Ruin Mode & Toxic Bio Chase to user
Awoken Jester of Ruin Mode: Unlimited Dark/Poison Hones, Dark/Poison Ability Boost & chases Dark/Poison abilities with 6 single-target Dark/Poison/NE magic attacks (2.41 each)
Toxic Bio: After using 2 Dark/Poison abilities, grants [Dark/Poison+50% Boost 1] to user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Dark, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Dark/Poison ability
